scope: Piano solo first, at the maintainer request. No string reworking in this review.
maintainerFeedback: The converted MIDI contains apparent incorrect pitches or note timing and repeated dissonances. The opening sequence already differs from the original.

firstAttack.name: D2
firstAttack.description: Additional detected D2 beside E2. An onset-only micro-event becomes a sustained audible MIDI note through the pedal.

diagnosis.policy: Private A1 rejects only detections shorter than 50ms with frame activation never reaching the model note-active threshold 0.1. This is a conservative rejection class, not proof of all true source notes.
diagnosis.openingAdditionalFindings: Private A2 also removes three source-reviewed G#3 re-attacks at 2.456, 5.005 and 5.603 original seconds while the source partials decay, and an E3 detection at 2.484 seconds without a separate fundamental/second-partial attack. Shared higher partials from the newly struck notes were considered. Two prior G#3 intervals are rejoined across false splits. No score pitch substitutions or quantization.

privateAudition.reviewStatus: first correction audition only; no listening approval or complete musical proofread
privateAudition.comparison: Source, published MIDI and corrected MIDI excerpts use original speed, original seconds 1.65–26.65, matched loudness and the same excerpt ending fade.

limitations: Long false notes, missing attacks, octave errors and pedal errors can remain. Technical MIDI checks and posterior scores do not prove musical accuracy. Version 1 score PDFs inherit the uncorrected MIDI. Existing published media and PDF bytes, pinned downloads and app source recording remain unchanged. No corrected media is published or promoted by this review.

targetedFollowUp.maintainerFeedback: The piano appears to stumble repeatedly at 2:51–3:12, more noticeably than in the original recording.
targetedFollowUp.timingAssumption: Reported 2:51–3:12 refers to slow A2; original interval is 142.499943–159.999936 seconds.
targetedFollowUp.evidence: Nine immediate repeated-pitch detections have no fresh increase above 2 dB in their first four partial envelopes (including the fundamental) in the original, including B4 re-attacks at sleep 180.722s and 181.049s. They follow the previous same-pitch key interval with a 5–15ms artificial split. In MIDI each becomes a new complete piano attack at estimated velocity, unlike a decaying/shared partial in the source.
targetedFollowUp.selectionCaution: This narrow source-envelope diagnostic is recording-specific and not a general true/false note classifier. Ambiguous shared harmonics and octave detections were left unchanged.

controlledRenders.method: Same A2 event timing, soundfont, EQ and original fixed gain; only room disabled or CC64 values set to zero. RMS difference describes signal contribution, not a perceptual blame percentage. All nine false note_on events remain in both controls.

targetedFollowUp.comparison: Original source, A2 and A3 excerpts at original tempo; source seconds 139.0–163.5, matched loudness, same excerpt fades. Reported interval begins 3.5 seconds into these clips.
targetedFollowUp.unchanged: All surviving note onsets, pitches and velocities, all pedal/CC91 events, YDP soundfont and processing; except eight explicit key-off restorations. No string changes. Published media/PDFs and app catalog untouched.
targetedFollowUp.limitations: Additional wrong or missing notes, octave errors, premature or overly long key holds and pedal errors can remain. Original source performance is not declared error-free. No complete score-forced correction or independent listening approval.

wholePieceFollowUp.maintainerFeedback: The reported 2:51–3:12 is the slow A2. Similar stumbling continues more mildly afterwards through the ending, and is less noticeable beforehand. This confirms the task covers the full piece.
wholePieceFollowUp.timingConfirmation: The maintainer confirms the 2:51–3:12 range refers to the slow A2 audition.
wholePieceFollowUp.scope: Solo piano only; entire source and MIDI audited, with special attention to reported section and subsequent ending.
wholePieceFollowUp.basis: A3, retaining all preceding A2/A3 edits.

method.higherPartials: Up to eight source partials; retain if a measured upper partial above -75 dB shows >4 dB growth.
method.quietAttackProtection: Retain if a first-four partial above -75 dB is >5 dB above a locally extrapolated prior decay; quieter genuine strikes may have no net amplitude increase.
method.acousticAnalysis: 128ms Hann-window STFT, 5ms hop, 16384 FFT; actual slightly-flat source pitch centers, +/-1% bands. 25–95ms post-onset median vs -130 to -60ms pre-onset median. Original source analyzed before any slowdown.
method.manualReview: All 35 conservative source-envelope candidates inspected in four review-page images. Ambiguous shared-harmonic and quiet-attack cases retained.
method.caution: These source-specific diagnostics support a private audition; they do not prove a perfect true/false note classifier or an error-free score. No global onset-confidence threshold, no key-only pruning, no performance quantization.

wholePieceFollowUp.unchanged: All surviving note attacks, pitches and velocities, every CC64/CC91/program event, selected YDP B timbre/EQ/reverb, constant loudness target, sleep speed; only documented false-repeat candidates and preceding key-off restorations changed. Strings, app catalog and committed audio/MIDI/PDF bytes untouched.
wholePieceFollowUp.limitations: 69 first-four-partial candidates retained due to possible quiet attacks or higher-partial evidence. Additional wrong/missing pitches, octave errors, uncertain key durations or pedal events may remain. Frequency of detected candidates is not a measure of perceived severity. Whole-piece listening review is still needed.

scoreBasedFollowUp.maintainerFeedback: A4 remains unconvincing. Find usable original scores/digital MIDI as a new starting point or plausibility reference; additionally audition Mutopia with its intended instruments.

maintainerFollowUp.maintainerFeedback: Both sound very mechanical and unattractive. They may only provide clues where melody and harmony in the performance-derived MIDI deviate too much.
maintainerFollowUp.scope: Reject the Mutopia flute/guitar and tonic64 score-based piano renditions as listening candidates. Preserve the YDP B instrument preference for performance-derived Berceuse work.
maintainerFollowUp.usePolicy: Use reference notation only to suggest specific melody, register or harmony checks. Confirm each proposed musical edit against the Jones source recording, accounting for arrangement differences. Preserve its expressive timing, rubato, velocities, overlaps and pedal, except for individually justified and documented correction of transcription mistakes. Do not wholesale replace performance events with score playback, quantize the performance globally, invent missing original four-hands voices, or make another score-only audition as a remedy for this feedback.

referenceComparisonSummary.method: For each retained A4 note, map its original onset onto the existing inferred bar grid. Look for its pitch class among sounding or nearby reference notes in a broad +/-0.5 quarter-beat window, in both reference editions. Retain cues absent from both only if original key duration >=90 ms and source velocity >=35. This tolerates octaves and some timing variation but is not an error detector.

basis.barGridStatus: Approximate performance-derived DTW grid; not an independently verified alignment.

referenceComparisonSummary.meaning: Unconfirmed comparison cues, not detected errors. No musical correction made.

reportedSection.interpretation: No shared reference pitch-class contrast in this broad-window comparison. This does not exclude wrong register, individual pitches within a broad sonority, repeat attacks, timing, sustain or alignment errors.

limitations: The references and the Jones performance are different arrangements. Legitimate passing notes, decorations, octave redistribution and harmony differences can remain unmatched.
DTW/bar-grid errors can create clusters of apparent mismatches.
Sustain acoustics, common harmonics and model ambiguity require checking actual recording evidence before removing or replacing any note.
A pitch-class match cannot certify correct melody, register, timing or harmony. No missing score voices are inserted.
The cue count is not an error count or a measure of perceived severity.

performancePreservingFollowUp.authorization: Maintainer accepted the proposed next step: exact opening/2:51-3:12 review, targeted correction preserving performance, short matched original/current/corrected comparison before whole-piece work.
performancePreservingFollowUp.basis: A4 original-performance and sleep MIDI. No new score-based rendition or string changes.
performancePreservingFollowUp.method: Local independent Basic Pitch analysis corroborates selected lower notes without sustained support for the putative octave notes. Source spectra and accompaniment-only partial profiles were inspected with notation used as contextual clues. Nineteen probable octave/shared-harmonic repeat artifacts are omitted in the two windows. These are proposed audition edits, not certified key-stroke recovery.

independentCheck.name: Spotify Basic Pitch
independentCheck.purpose: Corroboration of selected source attacks/pitches only. Different AMT models can share errors; no replacement MIDI generated.

performancePreservingFollowUp.performancePreservation: Only selected note-on/off pairs removed. Every surviving non-meta event is an exact subset of A4 at unchanged ticks and values, including all key-offs, velocities, CC64 and CC91. No quantization, pitch substitution, inserted original-score voices or key-off extension through pedal releases. YDP B processing retained.
limitations: Nineteen probable edits, not a certified error-free transcription. Independent models may share errors and can omit quiet real notes.
Reference editions differ from the Jones solo arrangement; no score-only missing-note restoration or full note replacement applied.

Source partial ratios can be confounded by overlap, reverb, velocity-dependent brightness, inharmonicity and weak denominator values. Full ratios are diagnostic data, not automatic rejection criteria.
Many uncertain octave/repeat/duration/pedal cases remain. Only the two audition windows are changed beyond A4. A5 is not a full-piece listening approval.
performancePreservingFollowUp.unchanged: Published MIDI/MP3/PDF bytes, catalog, strings, YDP B settings and previous audition files.

finalMaintainerDecision.feedback: A5 is not satisfactory either. Abandon the Faure conversion.
finalMaintainerDecision.outcome: No further correction work or synthesized replacement; retain original Brian M. Jones app recording and provenance of rejected attempts.
